method.local: Isolated Chromium via Playwright; CPU sampling + tracing for first two runs. Third run has neither CPU sampling nor tracing. Ready means the actual nested Studio right pane became visible; screenshots checked. No artificial network or CPU throttling.
method.online: Logged-in user Chrome, native DevTools Performance recording, warm assets, no throttling. Recording begins during initial startup; its 36.39-second duration includes idle time and is not editor load time.
method.backend: Source getProjectRev replay with native API-token authentication, real PostgreSQL, normal actor permission checks and same transaction wrapper as HTTP withNext. In-memory identity Response clones are reused within one diagnostic request only. Production server is unchanged.
method.desktop: Inspected installed /Applications/Plasmic.app app.asar. Full desktop launch trace was not obtained.

limitations: Local and online project copies have different saved revisions and canvas pages: local RecordsWebAcceptancePage versus online LocalEditAcceptance. End-to-end times are not a controlled cross-environment comparison.
Only a few runs, no P95 estimate. Active development and concurrent workloads can affect latency.
Online 503 failures were observed in a separate earlier session; the exported normal trace has successful API responses. Edge origin of the 503 is not confirmed.

confirmedCodeFindings.finding: Eager describeActor lookup on successful permission path.
Permission rows hydrate IAM users even in permission calculation path.
Versioned dynamic runtime responses use no-store.
Await latest dependency metadata and Plume before completing initializer.

recommendedOrder: Request-scoped IAM deduplication and reuse authenticated actor; lazy error descriptions.
Move latest-version metadata and unused Plume off first-canvas readiness, preserving required component synchronization.
Version/content-aware private caching of authorized runtime artifacts; retain authorization semantics.
Overlap project fetch with host bootstrap after project permission/trust resolution.
Separately trace and diagnose edge 503 failures; do not infer an application CPU bottleneck from them.
